tools.name: laws_for_business
tools.description: Given how a business uses AI and where its customers are, returns the laws in force and the ones coming, each with what must be disclosed, when, the penalties and the sources, plus the notice rules that satisfy all of them. Free, no account. Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_law
tools.description: The full record for one law: who must comply, what to disclose, timing, duties, exemptions, penalties, enforcement, sources and the last-verified date. Slugs come from list_laws or the dataset at https://botnotice.app/datasets/ai-disclosure-laws.json.

tools.name: list_laws
tools.description: Every AI disclosure law BotNotice tracks (U.S. states, federal, EU, UK), with status and effective date, optionally filtered. Also the pending bills.

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Reads a public website: which chat or voice-AI tools it runs, whether an AI disclosure is already shown, and, for the business described, which laws that leaves unmet. The same check as the free scan at botnotice.app/scan, without the browser pass. Not legal advice.
